HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.
   D. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.

2. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat National Security as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.
   C. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.
   B. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.

4. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

5. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

6. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   C. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   D. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

8. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

10. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

12. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.
   C. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

14. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.

15. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.
   C. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   C. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.

----
